One row per course and period for participation

Source: R/standard.R
course_period.Rd

The reusable analysis table. Source files are converted into this shape by an importer. Daily and monthly rows cannot share a table: adding them would count a month as a day. Unknown definitions stay unknown. This constructor does not infer tee-sheet capacity, cart bundling, taxes, or which rounds were membership play.

Usage

course_period(
  course_id,
  date,
  frequency,
  rounds,
  capacity = NA_real_,
  capacity_basis = "unknown",
  operating_status = "unknown",
  currency = "unknown",
  tax_treatment = "unknown",
  refund_treatment = "unknown",
  holes = "unknown",
  player_type = "unknown",
  service_or_posting = "unknown"
)

Arguments

course_id

Course identifier.

date

Period date. A daily row is the service date when that is known. A monthly row is the period start used by the source.

frequency

day or month. Every row in one table must match.

rounds

Rounds played. Missing stays missing.

capacity

Optional capacity count in rounds.

capacity_basis

Why capacity is that number.

operating_status

Open, closed, unknown, or a status already assigned by apply_operating_capacity().

currency

ISO currency code, or "unknown".

tax_treatment

How tax sits in the amounts, or "unknown".

refund_treatment

How refunds sit in the amounts, or "unknown".

holes

"9", "18", "mixed", or "unknown".

player_type

"daily_fee", "membership", "mixed", or "unknown".

service_or_posting

"service_date", "posting_date", or "unknown".

Value

A golfops_course_period tibble.
